name: docs budget: always-loaded vs on-demand tokens
description: Report token cost of the always-loaded set (rendered block + CLAUDE.md import chain) vs on-demand entries, per feature and per kind. Headline metric for condensing.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged 5ce3ec8. docs budget [--json] [--by feature|kind] [--top N] is read-only and exits 0. The estimate is max(ceil(chars/4), ceil(words*4/3)) (RepoCli.Core TokenEstimate, swappable). Always-loaded = CLAUDE.md outside the block + the block + its @import chain (relative paths, code fences skipped, cycles and depth 5 handled, ~/ imports external). Nested CLAUDE.md files are reported as contextual. Also shows the block if re-rendered now, on-demand totals by feature and kind, a worst-case push cost per policy, and the largest entries. Not measured: CLAUDE.local.md, ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.md files above the root, AGENTS.md.
